transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been forgetting small things I’m usually supposed to keep track of. Like, I’ll forget to return a call, or I’ll miss turning in a registration form, or I’ll mean to stop for an errand on the way home and just completely forget. It’s been happening enough that I thought I should get some help.
When did you first notice these memory problems?

I first really noticed it getting harder to manage about 15 months ago, when I started an evening certificate program. Since then, keeping track of things and staying organized has felt more difficult.
Are these memory problems causing any difficulties in your daily life or work?

Yes, a bit. I’m still managing day to day, but I’ve missed some small follow-ups at work and a few school deadlines. It’s happened enough that I’m starting to worry it could make me look unreliable, especially because I’d like to move into an Office Manager role eventually.
Have your memory problems been getting worse since you first noticed them 15 months ago?

I wouldn’t say it’s suddenly gotten worse, but it’s been noticeably harder to manage since I started the evening certificate program about 15 months ago. It’s kind of stayed more of a problem since then.
Have you had any trouble learning new things since you started noticing these memory problems?

I can learn new things, but I have trouble getting started when it takes a lot of reading or planning. Like if there’s a long chapter to read or I need to write out a plan, I’ll put it off until it’s late, and then I’m rushing through it after work.
Do you have trouble focusing or paying attention to things?

Yes, I do. At work or in class, it doesn’t take much to throw me off—like a phone ringing, people talking nearby, or even just suddenly thinking about something I need to do at home. Then I realize I’m not really focused on what I was doing anymore.
Have you ever found yourself unsure of the date, time, or your location?
No, not really. I know where I am and what day it is. I might lose track of time when I’m busy, but I don’t get confused about the date or where I am.
Do you ever find yourself struggling to find the right words when you're trying to express something?
Not really. I mean, sometimes I’ll pause for a second to think of how to say something, but I haven’t noticed a real problem finding words.
Do you have trouble making decisions?

Sometimes, yes. It’s not like I can’t decide anything, but I get stuck figuring out what to do first. I can usually keep up at work, but since I started evening classes, my desk, my class folder, and my email reminders kind of turn into piles, and then I waste time sorting through it all instead of just starting.
Have you ever felt disoriented or unclear about your surroundings?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t felt confused about where I am or what’s around me. Sometimes I’m distracted, but not disoriented.
Do you have trouble planning and organizing your daily tasks and activities?

Yes, a bit. I can usually manage at work, but since I started evening classes it’s gotten harder. My desk, my class folder, and my email reminders all kind of build up into piles, and then I spend too much time trying to figure out what I’m supposed to do first instead of just getting started.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
Not really. I mean, I get frustrated or overwhelmed sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been sad or down most of the time lately.
Do you ever have days where your thinking and memory seem sharper than others?

Some days do seem better than others, but what I notice more is the forgetfulness. I keep missing little things I normally handle, like forgetting to return a call, turn in a registration form, or stop for an errand on my way home. That’s really what made me ask for help.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
I haven’t really noticed being more tired than usual. I mean, I get worn out like anyone, but nothing that stands out as a big change.
Do you have trouble remembering things you've learned in the past?
I don’t think so, not really. I haven’t noticed a problem remembering things I learned before. It’s more like… if you mean old information, that seems okay.
Do you have trouble recalling information you've learned when you need it for a task or project?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed that as a big problem, at least not in a clear way. If I learned something before, I can usually pull it up when I need to.
Do you often forget to do things you had planned to do at a later time?

Yes, that’s actually been happening. I’ll plan to do something later, and then it just slips my mind—like returning a call, turning in a form, or stopping for an errand on the way home. It’s little things, but it’s been enough that I started feeling like I should ask someone about it.
Do you often forget to do things you had planned to do at a specific time?

Yes. It’s usually small things, but I’ll plan to do something at a certain time and then I just forget. Like returning a call, turning in a registration form, or stopping for an errand on the way home. That’s kind of what finally made me ask for help.
Do you often forget to do things you had planned to do in the future, like appointments or tasks?

Yes, I do. Like I said, it’s more the everyday little things—returning calls, turning in a registration form, or remembering to stop for an errand on the way home. It’s the kind of stuff I usually handle, but lately I’ll mean to do it and then it just slips my mind. That’s what made me decide to ask for help.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened to you in the past?

Not really, no. I mean, I don’t think I have trouble remembering past events in general. It’s more that I might forget to do something I meant to do later, but things that already happened to me… I haven’t noticed a problem with that.
